name: Vdara Hotel & Spa
insider_take: Vegas luxury without the chaos - Vdara is the Strip's best-kept secret for sophisticated travelers who want all-suite elegance with a serene, all-suite atmosphere.
whats_special: This sleek 57-story tower is the only all-suite, non-gaming, non-smoking hotel directly on the Strip. Each spacious suite features a full kitchen, floor-to-ceiling windows, and stunning city or mountain views. The rooftop pool deck offers rare tranquility amid the Vegas excitement, while the award-winning Spa & Salon Vdara provides world-class wellness treatments.
pro_tip: Book a suite on floors 40+ for breathtaking panoramic views, and use the sky bridge connection to Bellagio to access premium dining and entertainment without battling Strip foot traffic.
dont_miss: The infinity-edge Pool & Lounge with cabanas overlooking the Strip, Market Café Vdara for gourmet grab-and-go options, and the seamless access to Aria and Bellagio via climate-controlled walkways - giving you three world-class resorts at your fingertips.
pros: All-suite accommodations with full kitchens and spacious layouts
Prime location connected to Bellagio and walking distance to major attractions
cons: No casino on-site for gaming enthusiasts
Higher price point compared to traditional hotel rooms
